entry.description: Hand a batch to the `Append(LoggingEvent[])` overrides again, as before 3.0.0. Since 3.0.0 `DoAppend(LoggingEvent[])` passed a list and reached only `Append(IEnumerable)`, so a batch from a `BufferingForwardingAppender` took one file lock, one roll check and one flush per event. Now `FileAppender`, `RollingFileAppender` and `TextWriterAppender` take them once per batch, and `ForwardingAppender` hands each attached appender the whole batch in turn (A1, A2, B1, B2 instead of A1, B1, A2, B2). A subclass of these that overrides only `Append(LoggingEvent)` or `Append(IEnumerable)` no longer sees batches and should override `Append(LoggingEvent[])` as well. A failing file lock now costs the batch, and a size-rolled file can overshoot `MaxFileSize` by up to one batch (fixed by @FreeAndNil)
